source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 17 May 1967, p. 7 ("Unopposed returns: five to be fought")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: Quilly result from the Belfast Telegraph, 2 June 1967, p. 8; the unopposed divisions from the News-Letter's nomination report, 17 May 1967, p. 7.

note: Triennial election, polled Thursday 1 June 1967. Quilly was the only contest; the remaining divisions were filled without opposition. Returned unopposed; sitting member. Returned unopposed.
